quest.title: Unforeseen Circumstances
quest.description: You receive word of the latest crisis while trying to help Thoma win respect...

talks.objective: Ask the Yashiro Commission members questions
Tell Thoma of the Yashiro Commission emergency

dialogues.speaker: Yasutake
dialogues.text: Thank you for helping look into the situation with our deliveries.

talks.objective: Negotiate with the merchants in the city
Go with Thoma to meet "a friend"
Go to Konda Village and help with a delivery
Deliver the cargo out of the city
Go with Thoma to see Sakai

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: ...You're asking me what I think Thoma could do better?

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: He's busy enough as it is, don't you think? I barely see him around here at the Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: And when I do, more often than not, he's busy with the housework.

dialogues.speaker: Takashi
dialogues.text: I think he should carry on doing what he's doing. Everyone's got their own way of living, and Thoma's no different.

talks.objective: Find a sample of Noctilucous Jade
Go to the Yashiro Commission to witness the denouement of the emergency

dialogues.speaker: Sakai
dialogues.text: You can't buy Noctilucous Jade anywhere these days, it's been a real headache...

dialogues.speaker: Kiyoe
dialogues.text: I really hope the festival goes smoothly...

dialogues.speaker: Masanobu
dialogues.text: Greetings, welcome to the Yashiro Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Masanobu
dialogues.text: People have been talking about him behind his back? Surely not.

dialogues.speaker: Masanobu
dialogues.text: He does a wonderful job and always remains modest about it. Why would anyone single him out?

dialogues.speaker: Masanobu
dialogues.text: Huh, I can't figure it out. Try asking someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: So, have you had any ideas?
